title: Daddy Takes Care
subtitle: No Shhh’s Needed
tagline: Your baby is talking to you

lines: Daddy Takes Care.
No shhh’s needed.
Your baby is talking to you.
I sit in my crib, stretching my limbs, rolling onto my side.
I gnaw at my thumb, and wonder with a coo, where have you decided to hide?
You come in my room, whispering softly of well-wishes, so dear and true,
You smile, and I stick my tongue out, while smiling big, right back at you.
Now, high in my chair, wearing a bib, that catches the fallen food.
I take a bite, with such delight, the first time is, oh, so good.
We play on my tummy, it’s not always funny, but that’s how I learn how to crawl.
We sing and dance funny, and smile bright as it’s sunny, and learn how to reach for the ball.
Then it’s time to read again.
Quietly in my darkened room.
I’m read another short story,
The white noise reminds me of the womb.
I start to rub my eyes,
And rub my nose into your shoulder.
You snuggle me into my sleep sack,
And make it a little bit colder.
I’m pretty tired and drink some milk.
Boy, does it taste so delicious.
Poof, I’m asleep, and my tummy is full.
Dreaming of your kisses and well-wishes.
If done right, it’ll be a good day, with no shhh’s needed.
The end.
